# Elite Jewelry and Loan

> Family-owned jewelry store in Tempe, Arizona offering GIA-certified diamonds, estate jewelry at wholesale prices, collateral loans, and luxury watch services.

Elite Jewelry and Loan serves the Scottsdale and Tempe area with comprehensive jewelry services including buying, selling, trading, custom design, repairs, and asset-based loans on fine jewelry, diamonds, luxury watches, and designer handbags. The business specializes in wholesale pricing on GIA-certified diamonds and vintage estate pieces.

## Key Topics

- GIA-certified diamonds
- Collateral loans
- Estate jewelry
- Wholesale jewelry pricing
- Luxury watches
- Engagement rings
- Native American turquoise jewelry
- Designer handbags (Louis Vuitton, Chanel, Gucci, Hermes)
- Jewelry buying and selling
- Custom jewelry design
- Jewelry repair services
- Diamond dealers
- Tempe and Scottsdale, Arizona
- Asset-based lending
- Vintage jewelry collection
